items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser to keep skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support a comfortable skin barrier, since moisture reads on the low side.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, and zinc oxide formulas are a common pick for sensitive or changing skin.

response.routine_note: We have left out the adapalene gel because it is a retinoid and not a good fit while pregnant, so please ask your prenatal care provider or a dermatologist about your skin changes and what is safe for you. Until then, cleanse and moisturize morning and night and apply sunscreen each morning.
